rounds.title: Copy-button baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK copy button, drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design on the page. etCopyButton has no template or styling of its own; the drawing composes it as its docs do, on the default transparent md et-icon-button (39px round, 20px clipboard icon that becomes a check while copied() holds) and on an md et-text-button (14px Copy that becomes Copied!). States: idle, copied, failed, hover, active, focus-visible, copied-focus-visible, disabled. The copied feedback is only the icon or label swap, no colour change and no animation to freeze; a failed copy changes nothing on screen (only data-copy-failed and the hidden live region announcement Copy failed). Numbers, all passing except the ring: icon and label in ink 5.48:1 light, 13.50:1 dark (text needs 4.5, icon 3); hover ink on the 8 percent tint 7.44 / 11.39, focused on the 12 percent tint 7.32 / 10.26, active on the 16 percent tint 8.44 / 10.33. Copied equals idle (same ink). Disabled (0.4 opacity, exempt) 1.83 / 3.09. Today on light the focus ring is the focused mint: 1.37:1 against the page, 1.31:1 against the focused tint, under 3:1 (WCAG 2.4.11/1.4.11); dark 13.06:1 / 9.93:1. Q98, numbers only: the icon button's interaction tints against the page are 1.03 / 1.05 / 1.15 light and 1.19 / 1.32 / 1.31 dark (hover / focus / active); there is no edge. Q101 does not arise: the default copy button is transparent, no filled hover. Variant b applies a decided rule, not a new call: focus rings in --et-theme-color-ink-solid (Q88). Q99 rule a is already met: icon and label are ink today, and there is no mint dot, edge or stroke. b adds no edge, so Q102 does not arise and there is no c.

a.note: Today: focus ring in the focused primary, on light 1.37:1 against the page and 1.31:1 against the icon button's focused tint, under 3:1; dark 13.06:1 / 9.93:1. Icon and label in ink, 5.48:1 light, 13.50:1 dark.

b.note: Pick. Decided rule Q88, not a new call: both focus rings in --et-theme-color-ink-solid, light 7.68:1 against the page and 7.32:1 against the focused tint; dark 13.50:1 / 10.26:1 (ink is the mint, so dark barely moves from 13.06). Everything else as a. Picked to match the banner, notification and empty-state picks.
